title.narrative: Today's Youth, Future Jobs

description.narrative: The first specific objective is to upgrade and improve the skills of youth and adolescents to play active role in digitalisation and innovations, technological and economic changes. The second specific objective is to improve the capacities of Municipalities/Local Administrations and CSOs in Türkiye on digital skills development and job transition. The capacity will be increased in the piloted municipalities through establishment of digicenters, training of trainers programmes, workshops, conferences, study visits, trainings and awareness raising activities. Further trainings for the target groups will be developed through additional courses and internship opportunities.
